//: Deployment configuration for an installed copy of GMS.Desktop.
Leave ConnectionStrings.Gms empty here and DO NOT commit a real password to this file.
On the machine where GMS is installed, edit this file next to GMS.Desktop.exe and set:
Precedence, lowest to highest: this file, then user-secrets (developer machines only),
then the ConnectionStrings__Gms environment variable. Set the environment variable
instead of editing this file if you would rather keep the password out of the install.
If no connection string is found from any source the application starts in demo mode:
everything is held in memory and is lost when the window closes.
